B_score_normalization.details: No metric formula is introduced or altered by the controller. CPU comparison calls the unchanged v3 analyzer: IoU uses geometric union; frame mean divides by valid noninitialization GT frames; sequence macro mean is equal-weight over32 sequences; H10 counts contiguous valid-GT IoU<=0.1 runs of at least10 frames. Invalid GT breaks a run. The recorded gate requires future macro-IoU strictly greater than both native and current, and future H10 no greater than native. No denominator comes from a prediction maximum or other prediction statistic. Controller completion means all scheduled stages completed; gate=False is preserved as a negative development outcome, not turned into failure/retraining or a favorable score. Gate=True likewise does not launch R4.

C_result_existence.details: The teacher terminal evidence is actual: aggregate status complete, exit0,152 sequences,219802 native steps,1297 events,81908 future tracking calls. Its source/audit/hash provenance is present. Locally rehashed aggregate/shard/prefix bytes agree with the actual audit; no live progress query was used. The supplied real exit3 child fixture has matching launch/log/exit/receipt and failed-controller result/exit1. It is an isolated stdlib control-flow witness under Python3.13, not R3, not target Python3.8, not a Torch/NN result, and was not rerun. No new controller gate/deployment package or executed R3 preflight/fit/development/comparison artifacts are supplied. Planned counts, source-generated success fields and the existing fixture cannot be reported as learned C weights, runtime equality or metrics.

D_called_reached_code.details: The source main is reached by sys.exit(main()). It verifies admission, calls and validates the constant-action preflight, submits both fits and waits for both, validates their data/init/order/recipe, submits both full development32 histories and waits for both, then calls the CPU comparison. All six command templates were independently evaluated from their actual AST expressions using UNDEPLOYED placeholder paths, then parsed by the corresponding exact argparse statements without importing any experiment module. All six parsed correctly. The controller is stdlib-only; it enforces Python3.8 and assertions before work, passes -B/-u and PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 to children, sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES explicitly, and sets code_root/base_code_root PYTHONPATH. Syntax/static reachability is not actual target import or execution. The local fixture helper uses Python3.13-only convenience APIs and is explicitly a local helper, not a target stage.

technical_source_checks.title: Preflight must succeed before any trained C model
technical_source_checks.details: preflight runs synchronously on GPU0 first. Nonzero exit immediately routes to failed(). A zero exit additionally requires the exact complete status,256 frames,at least one actual qualified write, both equality flags,zero optimizations/constructed C MLPs and exact teacher/audit joins. Only then are train subprocesses submitted. The writer fixtures are plain parameter-free Python objects; their existing import of the C class definition does not instantiate a learned C. This guarantees ordering in source, not the outcome of an unexecuted runtime preflight.

technical_source_checks.title: Paired fixed-budget fits and complete own histories
technical_source_checks.details: enumerate(current,future) maps GPU0/GPU1 consistently in both fits and development. Both fits receive the same teacher-root, teacher-audit,spec,split and frozen source architecture. Training builds one common sorted manifest with no sign filtering, seeds before CPU TemplateWriteC construction, hashes the CPU initial state, uses its own seeded CPU randperm generator and fixed10-epoch final. The controller requires actual993/264 counts,320 steps,10 epochs,seed2027 and audit SHA, then equality of common_dataset_sha256, initial_state_sha256 and order_sha256 before either development process. Each development reads its own final/result, checks hashes and runs every noninitialization frame of32 sequences from first-box initialization with frozen A+B/native/CLIP/C. The analyzer checks actual per-frame completeness, C/result/prediction hashes, matching teacher provenance and unchanged original-prefix bindings. CUDA initialization equality/updates and the SHA values of future C checkpoints are not measured in this review.

technical_source_checks.title: Blocking waits, ordinary failure receipts and no restart
technical_source_checks.details: run invokes subprocess.run with an argv list, explicit cwd/env, combined log and no shell. It records launch before waiting, then writes the actual returncode to .exit and .receipt.json. Each parallel group submits both jobs, blocks on Future.result(), and exits its executor context before inspecting exits; a failed sibling is not restarted and the other already-launched sibling is allowed to finish. A returned nonzero exit in any of four phases writes M122_R3_C_stage_failed with accumulated receipts and controller.exit1; downstream phases do not start. No poll loop,sleep,timeout,retry,timer or R4 invocation exists. The real exit3 fixture corroborates this ordinary returncode path only. Spawn/I/O/JSON/assertion exceptions propagate and do not synthesize a controller result/exit file; no universal exception-receipt guarantee is claimed. The future outer launcher must retain actual controller process exit/stderr, including that boundary.

technical_source_checks.title: Unchanged prescribed comparison, no automatic R4

Both positive and negative scientific outcomes can have operational status complete. R4_requires_fresh_result_audit remains true and R4_launched/formal_nine_metrics remain false; there is no source call that can launch R4. The boolean is not a substitute for the required coverage/per-sequence result audit.
